arms.A: official mask loss; train entire native cv4
arms.B: official loss plus direct prototype-response preservation objective
arms.C: official loss plus Bernoulli response distillation from 5-step coefficient solver

auxiliary.reference_precision: FP32 on detached feature tensors; main training keeps saved AMP setting

protection_reference: fixed pretrained cv4 evaluated on same transformed image features; reference-correct pixels only
reference_revision_reason: current-output self-reference gives zero guard/trust gradient at each B update; use fixed initial head for B and C
bn: running mean/variance frozen in ALL modules; cv4 weights and affine parameters trainable
assignment: official one2many positive assignment captured in native loss; at most two uniformly selected candidates per GT for B/C auxiliary
primary_checkpoint: epoch8 EMA cv4; no validation checkpoint/alpha selection

evaluation.mask_decode: official process_mask_native on 640 input; official scale_masks with letterbox ratio_pad to original shape, as native JSON export

training_config: supported saved checkpoint train_args; declared short budget, partial parameter training, fixed BN; hardware/output overrides
limitations: equal outer steps, unequal teacher compute
sampled auxiliary pixels; original official mask loss unchanged
queue: prepare, smoke A/B/C, train A/B/C, evaluate R/A/B/C, paired summary; independent run ID each
